Palestinians in the occupied West Bank and Gaza are paying the price for an
[election](https://zeteo.com/p/how-israels-defenders-use-palestinian?r=3uiw9m)
they can't vote in.

While Israel's political future dominates headlines, its "full lockdown" of
the occupied West Bank and ongoing bombings in Gaza received far less
attention. Whatever the [outcome](https://zeteo.com/p/meet-the-5-israeli-
politicians-trying?r=3uiw9m) of Israel's election, the result will be the
same: more of the occupation, dispossession, and killing that Palestinians saw
this week.

Israel killed at least 15 Palestinians, including a 6-year-old girl shot in
the neck, in separate incidents across Gaza this week, while simultaneously
terrorizing Palestinians, journalists, and
[activists](https://x.com/AdeleShoko/status/2115564949695283489) across the
occupied West Bank.

In Hebron - a total closure of which was ordered after Palestinian gunmen
[killed](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/24/why-is-israel-launching-a-
new-military-operation-in-the-occupied-west-bank) two Israeli soldiers -
occupation forces [forcibly displaced
thousands](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/10/1168672) of Palestinians,
demolishing homes after giving some families just minutes to collect their
belongings.

There, Israeli police also arrested U.S. journalist Jasper Nathaniel and
activist Andrey Kharzhanovsky _after_ illegal Israeli settlers attacked them -
yes, you read that right.

While Israelis flocked to voting booths to decide who leads the oppression and
occupation of Palestinians next, here is what Palestinians who don't get a
vote had to endure this week:
